description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007 Order Under Section 2 and Section 5
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the imposition and modification of a Special Commodity Levy under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007. It contains regulatory orders regarding tax rates on specific imported commodities, which falls under the category of Legal/Regulatory matters (new regulations, statutory instruments, and compliance requirements). While it mentions a government official (Ranil Wickremesinghe), the core content is about regulatory changes rather than government personnel or structural changes, making Type 5 the appropriate classification.
